==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand wanders the Stone, reminiscing about his earlier travels with [[Mat]], [[Perrin]], [[Loial]] and [[Hurin]]. He wonders about the prophecies about ''[[Callandor]]'' and the lack of any mention of the ''[[Choedan Kal]]''. He considers kicking [[Cadsuane]] from the Stone to enforce his exile. His anger is buried deep but is still there because of the defiance of the [[Borderlander|Borderlanders]], the [[Seanchan]] and the [[Aes Sedai]]. Perhaps he should use the Choedan Kal against the Seanchan. He recalls his attempt to bring a dead girl back to life, the memory prompted by [[Lews Therin]]. He resolves to drive the Seanchan back in to the sea.

He returns to his rooms and finds [[Tam]] waiting. Their meeting starts out awkward since Rand has changed so much. They finally begin to chat a bit more normally. Tam is giving encouragement to Rand when he accidentally mentions [[Cadsuane]] which infuriates Rand so much he almost kills Tam, almost channels [[balefire]] to kill everyone. He sees Tam's terrified face and comes to his senses. He weaves a [[gateway]] to [[Ebou Dar]].
